description: Sample C source code demonstrating Redis client operations using hiredis, including connection setup, enabling RESP3 protocol, client tracking, handling push messages, and key updates.

methods.name: assertReplyAndFree
methods.description: Checks reply type and frees reply object, aborting on errors.

methods.name: enableClientTracking
methods.description: Switches Redis connection to RESP3 protocol and enables client tracking.

methods.name: pushReplyHandler
methods.description: Handles Redis push messages for invalidations, updating count and printing info.

methods.name: privdata_dtor
methods.description: Destructor for private data, logs invalidation count.
